requests.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL GAME VFX SPRITE SHEET for a chibi wuxia elevated top-down 3/4 orthographic pixel art RPG. This is NOT a concept sheet. One magical protective LOTUS FLOWER growing flat on the ground, cyan/white with pale jade accents, luminous outlined layered petals, subtle pixel sparkles. Clear open center where hero feet will stand. Camera fixed, ground flower is an ellipse in perspective, width twice its height; not a side view flower. Detailed crisp pixel clusters, no soft blur, no vector geometry, no text, no labels, no borders, no characters, no scenery. EXACT uniform 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS of 8 cel images, on transparent background, total image 1024x512 pixels, equal 256x256 cells. Every cel centered at cell center; identical perspective, anchored center at same relative cell coordinate. Flower width about 190 px, height about 100 px at full bloom. Sequence left-to-right row-major: cells 0-3 opening (tiny luminous bud, quarter open petals, half open petals, fully open lotus); cells 4-7 four subtly different fully open loop cels with individual petals flexing and small rising sparkles. Leave at least 24 transparent pixels around each cel. All 8 cels form one consistent flower with identical color and outline style. Hand-finished wuxia pixel VFX, cyan white wind school. Actual alpha background.

Original 2D wuxia pixel-art game VFX SPRITESHEET, 4 columns by 2 rows, eight separated cels on real transparent background. No text, borders, characters, scenery or labels. Golden Buddhist PALM PROJECTILE: unmistakable OPEN HUMAN HAND silhouette with FIVE fingers pointing RIGHT, thumb visible, fingers separated; luminous golden yellow outlines, warm amber core, white gold highlights, crisp intentional pixel clusters. Stylized energy hand, not photorealistic, not a fist, not a crescent, not an arrow. Elevated 3/4 top-down RPG view. Each cel occupies equal 256x256 cell, keep substantial transparent gutters, center identical cell-relative position, fixed scale and anchor. Total requested 1024x512. Top row four consecutive travel-animation cels: the SAME OPEN PALM facing RIGHT with subtle finger-energy movement, trailing gold flame ribbons to LEFT and short sparks. Palm about 90px wide at source scale; total palm and wake about 170px wide, 115px high. Bottom row four consecutive IMPACT cels: same hand strikes to right, luminous handprint burst, layered finger echoes, expanding gold shards dissipate. Maintain hand anatomy and visual identity throughout. Detailed chibi martial arts RPG authored pixel VFX; hard edged pixels not blur, no giant opaque glow disc. Alpha transparency.

ORIGINAL wuxia RPG pixel-art SWORD ENERGY sprite sheet: 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 separate equal 256x256 transparent cells, requested canvas 1024x512. Fixed ground-independent VFX view suitable for elevated top-down orthographic 2D game. No characters, labels, text, background, border or UI. Top row FOUR distinct consecutive animation cels of the SAME long straight narrow silver-blue Chinese jian sword, pointed RIGHT, crossguard and hilt at left, visible blade tip on right. Blade ~150 px long in each 256px cell with 40px transparent margins. Pale blue white energy wake trailing left, crisp pixel clusters, dark blue edge outline to remain readable over stone ground. Distinct solid SWORD silhouette, not an arrow or crescent. Same scale and anchor, slight energy ribbons flicker/change around the blade across the four cels. Bottom row FOUR animation cels of a blue-white seven-point constellation STAR FLASH / sword impact: small spark expanding into seven connected bright starlike glints with slender angular sword-energy shards, then scattering fragments and fading. Each effect centered inside its own cell. Detailed hand-finished chibi martial arts pixel VFX style, limited silver/white/ice blue/indigo palette, real alpha, no soft blur, no big opaque discs, no extra objects. All cells separate with transparent gutters.
